title: AIT Tardis Crafting
description: Adds a recipe for the AIT creative tardis item.
body:
This datapack adds a recipe for the **Adventures In Time** Creative TARDIS item using AIT's blueprint system

**However,**
You will eventually need to, 
- Get an actual Engine
- Get the Subsystems
- Repair the Subsystems
- Connect the Subsystems to the Engine

**Due to how the TARDIS item works you will be granted with OWNER loyalty immediately**

**I chose what i thought would be best for a TARDIS**
